dublinCore.dc:title: 99 HR 22 IH: Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act or the SAVE Act.

section.header: Ensuring only citizens are registered to vote in elections for Federal office

subsection.header: Definition of documentary proof of United States citizenship
subsection.text: Section 3 of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (52 U.S.C. 20502) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking As used and inserting (a) In general.—As used; and

section.text: This Act and the amendments made by this Act shall take effect on the date of the enactment of this Act, and shall apply with respect to applications for voter registration which are submitted on or after such date.
